name: construction
description:
Modern Builders provides construction in South Pasadena, Glendale, Burbank. Quality Construction, Restoration, and Property Protection for Pasadena and Southern California
Modern Builders is a licensed California contractor based in Pasadena, serving homeowners, property managers, and light-commercial property owners throughout Southern California. Led by CEO Bryan Peralta, a contractor with more than 25 years of industry experience, Modern Builders delivers high-quality repair, restoration, installation, and improvement services designed to protect the appearance, performance, and long-term value of every property.

Since 2017, Modern Builders has built its business around a straightforward standard: provide dependable workmanship, solve problems correctly, communicate clearly, and treat every customer’s home or building with care. Whether a client needs a minor repair, a targeted restoration, or a larger improvement project, the team brings practical field experience, detailed project planning, and a commitment to lasting results.

Modern Builders specializes in the systems that protect a property from the outside in. From damaged stucco and water intrusion to roofing concerns, cracked drywall, worn paint, and deteriorating exterior finishes, the company helps clients identify the cause of the issue—not simply cover up the visible symptom. The goal is to provide a solution that improves curb appeal, protects structural components, reduces future maintenance concerns, and gives property owners confidence in their investment.

Services Built Around Your Property
Modern Builders provides a broad range of residential and light-commercial contracting services, including:

Stucco repair, crack repair, patching, resurfacing, and restucco work

Stucco remediation and exterior restoration

Waterproofing and moisture-intrusion solutions

Building-envelope repair and protection

Residential roofing services and roofing-project coordination

Drywall installation, drywall repair, texture matching, and finishing

Interior and exterior painting

Exterior coatings and surface protection

Residential remodeling, repairs, and property improvements

Light-commercial repair, maintenance, and restoration projects

Every property is different. Modern Builders evaluates each project based on the condition of the structure, the visible damage, the likely source of the problem, the owner’s goals, and the best path toward a durable repair. That problem-solving mindset helps clients make informed decisions instead of investing in temporary fixes that may fail over time.

More Than Cosmetic Repairs
A crack in stucco, a stain on a ceiling, peeling paint, or deteriorating exterior finishes can be a sign of a deeper issue. Water intrusion, roofing failures, compromised coatings, movement in the building structure, damaged drywall, and aging materials can all affect the condition and value of a property.

Modern Builders takes a detail-oriented approach to repair and restoration. The team works to understand what is happening beneath the surface, explain the available options, and recommend a solution that aligns with the property’s needs and the customer’s budget. When appropriate, that may include focused repairs; for more extensive concerns, it may involve remediation, waterproofing, resurfacing, or coordinated restoration work.

This approach is especially valuable for property owners who want a contractor that can address both the visible finish and the underlying conditions affecting the building.

Why Clients Choose Modern Builders
Choosing a contractor is about more than hiring someone to complete a task. Property owners need a team they can trust to show up, communicate honestly, protect the jobsite, respect the property, and stand behind the quality of its work.

Modern Builders is built around those expectations.

25+ years of construction experience: Bryan Peralta brings decades of hands-on knowledge in repairs, installations, restoration, and property improvement.

Licensed California contractor: Clients work with an established contractor committed to professional standards and quality execution.

Pasadena-based, Southern California focused: The company understands the materials, climate conditions, property types, and exterior-maintenance challenges common throughout the region.

Residential and light-commercial capability: Modern Builders works with homeowners, landlords, property managers, and business owners.

A practical, solution-first process: The company focuses on identifying the problem, presenting clear options, and completing work with long-term performance in mind.

Recognized industry affiliations: Modern Builders is a GAF Preferred Contractor, Parex USA Preferred Contractor, and Sherwin-Williams Paint Partner.

Customer-focused service: The company’s 5-star Yelp reviews reflect its emphasis on reliability, craftsmanship, professionalism, work ethic, and customer satisfaction.

A Better Experience From Start to Finish
Modern Builders believes a successful project starts with listening. The team begins by understanding the property owner’s concerns, assessing the project requirements, and discussing the condition of the affected area. Clients receive straightforward communication about the recommended scope of work, expected outcomes, and the steps involved in completing the project.

Throughout the job, Modern Builders aims to keep communication clear, maintain an organized work area, and deliver work that meets the company’s standards for quality and durability. The team understands that construction work can disrupt daily life or business operations, which is why professionalism, planning, and respect for the customer’s time and property remain central to every project.

Protect Your Property With Modern Builders
Your home or commercial property is a major investment. Whether you are dealing with cracked stucco, signs of water damage, an aging roof, damaged drywall, failing paint, or a larger restoration need, Modern Builders is ready to help you move forward with clarity and confidence.

From the first assessment through final completion, Modern Builders delivers experienced guidance, quality craftsmanship, and practical solutions designed to protect your property for years to come.

Contact Modern Builders today to schedule a consultation and discuss your residential or light-commercial construction, restoration, repair, waterproofing, stucco, roofing, drywall, or painting project.
